account_code.description: The account's code in the entity's chart.

counterparty_entity_id.description: For an intercompany account, the other entity of the group.

counterparty_parent.description: For an intercompany account, the parent itself is the other side.

entity_id.description: The entity's row in the group; leave it out for the parent's own accounts (only an intercompany account needs a mapping of its own).

group_account_id.description: The parent's account (not a group account) it maps to.
